note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a No provision; A06b No provision; L05 No provision): no ordinary naturalisation by residence; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generally applicable provision), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, with no further limit on a child born abroad. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Nauru, 2024
sources.said: n.a. ... n.a. ... n.a. (Dual citizenship expressly permitted by NRU 16) ... Generally applicable provision ... Person born in Nauru is a citizen by birth, provided that at the time of the person<d5>s birth either or both parents is a citizen (Citizenship Act 2017 s 9). Person born after 31 January 1968 is a citizen if both parents were Nauruan citizens, or if born of a marriage between a Nauruan and Pacific Islander and neither parent seeks a foreign citizenship for the child immediately after birth (Const 72). ... Generally applicable provision ... Person born outside Nauru and one or both parents are citizens is deemed a citizen (Citizenship Act 2017 s 12(1)). Person is a citizen if born after 31 January 1968 to two Nauruan parents or of a marriage between a Nauruan and Pacific Islander and neither parent seeks a foreign citizenship for the child immediately after birth (Const 72). ...
